description: Standard alert-handling process should generate valid BPMN with ≥2 lanes
input: 设计一个充电桩告警诊断与自恢复流程：设备端检测到异常后上报告警，云端Agent分析告警类型，低风险的自动执行恢复命令，高风险的转人工确认后再执行，执行后验证恢复结果并生成报告
expected_behavior: Layer 1 parses intent (alert-handling), extracts entities (设备端, 云端Agent, 运维人员). Layer 2 matches template. Layer 3 produces exclusiveGateway for risk decision. Output .bpmn has 2+ lanes, passes validation.

description: Ambiguous description should trigger clarification before proceeding

description: Approval workflow with loop-back should produce loop_back edge in DAG
input: 员工提交工单，主管审批，不通过则退回修改，通过后系统自动分配工程师
expected_behavior: Layer 2 decompose produces loop_back edge (reject→resubmit). Layer 3 creates exclusiveGateway for approve/reject. Output .bpmn has loop-back sequenceFlow. Validation passes.
